purpose: Distribute a read-only live overlay to separately deployed paid handlers without changing canonical yield evidence.

distribution.local: live_worker.py may mirror into blocks_deploy/*/live_data/ when LIVE_WORKER_MIRROR_DEPLOYMENTS=1.
distribution.container: Mount the same named or managed volume at /app/live_data in the worker and every consumer runtime; consumers must mount it read-only.
distribution.hosted_blocks: A local volume is not visible to hosted Blocks runtimes. Use an approved object-store, sidecar, or deployment-sync mechanism and preserve atomic replacement plus the same filenames.

write_policy: Worker writes atomically; consumers read only and never modify or replace the snapshot.
freshness_policy: Consumers must require data_status=live_overlay_only, a fresh generated_at, and observation_status not equal to retained_from_previous_cycle.
failure_policy: Worker liveness and data readiness are separate. degraded or no_fresh_observation states must alert and must not be presented as fresh live data.
paid_task_policy: Handlers never make provider network calls during a paid task; the overlay is optional, separately labeled context.
